title: Adventure Illustrators at the Rockwell
content: Left: Frank Schoonover (1877–1972)Canadian TrapperRight: Greg Manchess,Above the Timberline(detail) ©ManchessTwo exhibitions have opened at the Norman Rockwell Museum which highlight illustrators of adventure. One focuses onFrank Schoonover, a Howard Pyle student who painted scenes from history and outdoor life, and the other show features the oil paintings byGreg Manchessfor his recent bookAbove the Timberline.-----Books:Above the TimberlineandFrank Schoonover, Illustrator of the North American FrontierSpeaking of adventure illustrators, the recent Tom Lovell book is going into a second printing if the publisher can get enoughsubscriptions on Kickstarter.
